chat.admin_remove_confirm: Remove this from {name}'s profile? They can set a new one. It is noted in the audit log.
chat.ai_missed_prompt: What did I miss in Rooms (team chat)? Sum up the unread messages by channel and person, mentions and questions to me first.
chat.ai_thread_prompt: Summarize the thread in Rooms (team chat) (channel {room}, room {roomId}, thread {rootId}): what is it about, what was decided, what is open and who does what?
chat.archive_confirm: Archive {name}? Nobody can write there any more; messages stay readable.
chat.background_for_all_hint: A picture or gradient behind the messages – for everyone in the channel. Each person can choose something else for themselves.
chat.background_for_dm_hint: A picture or gradient behind the messages – for everyone in this conversation. Each person can choose something else for themselves.
chat.background_hidden_note: Channel backgrounds are hidden for you. Choose one here to see it in this channel anyway.
chat.background_hide_all: Hide backgrounds in all channels and conversations
chat.background_hide_all_hint: Only for you. A background you chose yourself for a channel or conversation stays.
chat.background_image_hint: JPEG, PNG or WebP (the first frame of a GIF). Made smaller before uploading and kept with the chat's files.
chat.background_image_invalid: Please choose a picture: JPEG, PNG, WebP or GIF, at most 30 MB.
chat.background_image_set: {name} set an own picture as the background
chat.background_mine_hint: Only you see this choice, on all your devices.
chat.background_who: The channel's managers and the company's admin can change it for everyone; in direct messages, everyone in the conversation.
chat.banner_custom_hint: A photo, or an animated GIF or WebP (up to 5 MB); shown as a 3:1 strip.
chat.beginning: This is the very beginning of {name}.
chat.beginning_dm: This is the beginning of your conversation with {name}.
chat.canvas_empty: No canvas yet. Notes, links and how things work in this channel go here – for everyone.
chat.channel_unavailable: This channel is not available to you.
chat.contact_rule_github: GitHub: a user name (letters, digits and -) or an https address.
chat.contact_rule_linkedin: LinkedIn: the name from your profile address or https://…
chat.contact_rule_phone: A phone number: digits, spaces and + ( ) / . -
chat.contact_rule_telegram: Telegram: a user name (4–32 letters, digits or _) or https://t.me/…
chat.contact_rule_x: X: a user name (up to 15 letters, digits or _, no dots) or an https address.
chat.create_external: Share with other companies (external channel) – invitation only
chat.create_kind_forum_hint: Posts with a title and tags; replies go in each post's thread.
chat.create_kind_voice_hint: As in Discord: click in and talk, no appointment. The text chat stays next to it.
chat.create_public: Open — everyone in the company can find and join it
chat.delete_confirm: Delete this message? This cannot be undone.
chat.details_archived: This channel is archived: it can be read, but no one can post.
chat.details_integrations_text: Webhooks post messages from other programs into this channel (like Slack webhooks).
chat.details_pinned_none: No pinned messages yet. Pin one with “⋯” on the message.
chat.details_posting_managers_hint: For announcements: everyone reads, managers post. Replies in threads are for managers too.
chat.details_remove_confirm: Remove {name} from #{channel}? They can be invited again.
chat.drafts_empty: No drafts. What you start in a channel and do not send shows here – on every device.
chat.email_access_note: Opens if you have access to this e-mail.
chat.email_share_hint: Subject, sender and the beginning are shared. Only people who have the e-mail themselves can open it – for example in a shared mailbox.
chat.enable_failed: Rooms could not be turned on. Please try again.
chat.error: That did not work. Please try again.
chat.ext_federation_off: Your company does not chat with other companies at the moment.
chat.ext_hint: People from other companies: enter their Rooms address (@name:company.com) or e-mail address.
chat.ext_invite: From outside your company ({domain}). Accept only if you know the sender.
chat.ext_server_not_allowed: Your company may not chat with this server (Administration → Rooms).
chat.external_privacy: Messages in external channels and conversations with other companies are also stored on their servers; their rules apply there.
chat.home_text: Pick a channel or a person on the left. Press Ctrl+K to jump anywhere.
chat.hooks_intro: Incoming webhooks in Slack's format: services such as GitHub, GitLab, Grafana, uptime monitors, forms or Zapier post messages into the channel through this address. Wherever a "Slack incoming webhook" is asked for, this address works.
chat.hooks_limit: A channel can have at most 10 integrations.
chat.hooks_name_hint: e.g. GitHub Actions or website form
chat.hooks_none: No integrations in this channel yet.
chat.hooks_remove_confirm: Remove "{name}"? The address stops working; earlier messages stay in the channel.
chat.hooks_rotate_confirm: The current address stops working at once. Then enter the new address in the other service.
chat.hooks_secret_note: Anyone who knows the address can post into this channel. Enter it only in services you trust; if it became known, create a new one.
chat.later_empty: Nothing for later. Get reminded about a message (“⋯” → Remind me) or send a message later (clock next to “Send”).
chat.later_error_room: Not sent: you are no longer in the channel.
chat.later_past: Please choose a time in the future.
chat.link_prompt: Address of the link (the selected words become the link).
chat.long_paste: Long text – send it as a snippet?
chat.mentions_empty: No mentions in the loaded messages.
chat.no_permission: You cannot write in this channel.
chat.notify_app_auto: Automatic – XenRooms when installed, otherwise Xenaxio
chat.notify_app_hint: With both apps installed, the chat notifies in one of them only. Mail, meetings and the assistant always notify in Xenaxio.
chat.notify_default_hint: Set single channels differently in the channel under the bell, or in the sidebar with “⋯”. “Nothing” turns off all chat notifications, single channels too.
chat.notify_email: Send an e-mail when a mention has been unread for 24 hours
chat.notify_keywords_hint: e.g. offer, Miller – separated by commas
chat.notify_preview: Show the message text in notifications
chat.notify_preview_hint: When off, they only say who wrote where — good for the lock screen.
chat.notify_schedule: Do not disturb on a schedule
chat.notify_schedule_hint: Applies to all your devices. If the time ends the next morning, the morning belongs to the day selected before it.
chat.notify_schedule_invalid: Please enter a start, an end and at least one day.
chat.poll_hide_results: Show results only after the end
chat.profile_contact_move: Move contact {n} (drag, or Space and the arrow keys)
chat.profile_framer_drag: Drag to choose the part shown
chat.profile_framer_hint: Drag the picture or use the arrow keys to choose the part shown.
chat.profile_invalid: Please check the details (contacts: user name, number or https address).
chat.profile_picture_hint: A photo, or an animated GIF or WebP (up to 2 MB). Pictures are saved right away.
chat.profile_picture_unreadable: This picture cannot be read. Please choose a JPEG, PNG, WebP or GIF.
chat.push_banner: Turn on notifications to see new messages and mentions even when Rooms is closed.
chat.push_denied: Notifications are blocked for this site in the browser. Allow them in the browser's site settings.
chat.push_disabled: Push notifications are switched off on this server. You see new messages while Xenaxio is open.
chat.push_failed: Notifications could not be turned on.
chat.push_unsupported: This browser cannot receive notifications. On iPhone: add Xenaxio to the Home Screen and open it there.
chat.read_only: This channel is archived and read-only.
chat.report_text: The report goes to your company's administrators. Why are you reporting the message? (optional)
chat.saved_empty: Nothing saved yet. Save messages from “More actions”.
chat.shortcuts: Shortcuts: Ctrl+K jump, Alt+↑/↓ switch channel, ↑ edit last message, Esc mark as read
chat.side_delete_section_confirm: Delete section “{name}”? Its channels go back to “Channels” and “Direct messages”.
chat.side_empty_section: Drag channels here or move them with “⋯”
chat.signed_out: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
chat.slash_me: An action in the third person
chat.slash_no_person: Person not found – type @ and pick from the list.
chat.slash_nothing_to_remind: There is no message here yet.
chat.slash_remind: Remind me of the last message
chat.slash_unknown: “/{name}” is not a command. For text that starts with “/”, put a space before it.
chat.snippet_too_large_edit: Too large to edit – send a new snippet instead.
chat.starting_text: This usually takes just a moment. The page updates by itself.
chat.title: Rooms
chat.unavailable_admin: Rooms is turned off for your company. Turn it on here; it takes just a moment.
chat.unavailable_text: Rooms is turned off for your company. Please ask your administrator to turn it on.
chat.voice_cannot_play: This browser cannot play the recording. Download it instead.
chat.voice_empty: Nobody in the voice channel right now.

voice_errors.audio_refused: The speech model could not read this recording.
voice_errors.audio_too_large: The recording is too large to transcribe.
voice_errors.demo_ai_limit: The demo's AI requests are used up.
voice_errors.internal: That did not work. Please try again.
voice_errors.message_not_found: The message is no longer there.
voice_errors.rate_limited: Too many requests. Please wait a minute.
voice_errors.transcription_failed: The speech model did not answer. Please try again later.
voice_errors.voice_download_failed: The recording could not be loaded. Please try again.

chat.voice_failed: The voice message could not be sent.
chat.voice_limit: Voice messages can be up to 5 minutes long: this one was sent.
chat.voice_mic_denied: No access to the microphone. Allow it in the browser (the icon next to the address) and try again.

voice_unavailable.ai_disabled: Transcripts are an AI function, and AI is switched off for you or your company.
voice_unavailable.ai_limit_reached: Your monthly AI allowance is used up.
voice_unavailable.ai_not_configured: No speech model is set up for your company.
voice_unavailable.free_limit_reached: This month's transcripts in XenRooms Free are used up. The paid plan has no such limit.
voice_unavailable.speech_server_missing: The company's speech server is not set up.
voice_unavailable.transcription_model_missing: The admin has not named the speech model yet.
voice_unavailable.transcription_off: Your company's admin has switched transcription off.

chat.voice_unsupported: This browser cannot record voice messages.

rooms.add_subtitle: Sign in with your Xenaxio account of the other company. Then switch on the left with one click.
rooms.chat_address_hint: Part of every chat address in your company, e.g. @anna:mueller.xenrooms.app. It cannot be changed later.
rooms.forgot_sent: If {email} has a XenRooms account, a link is on its way. It is valid for one hour.
rooms.forgot_subtitle: Enter your work email. If it has a XenRooms account, we send you a link to set a new password.
rooms.invite_submit: Set password and open the chat
rooms.invite_subtitle: {company} invites you to its team chat. Choose your password.
rooms.link_expired: This link has expired. Ask your administrator for a new invitation, or request a new password link.
rooms.link_used: This link has already been used. Sign in with your password, or ask for a new link.
rooms.login_subtitle: The team chat for all your companies – sign in with your work email.
rooms.moved_subtitle: {company} now uses Xenaxio. Set the password for your new address.
rooms.own_domain: Use our own domain for chat addresses
rooms.own_domain_hint: Chat addresses then end with it, e.g. @anna:mueller.de. Your email stays where it is. The chat starts at once; other companies reach it once you put a small file on your website or a DNS record – shown under Administration → Rooms. It cannot be changed later.
rooms.people_block_confirm: Block {email}? They are signed out at once and cannot sign in until you unblock them.
rooms.people_chat_domain: Chat addresses of your company end in “:{domain}”.
rooms.people_chat_settings: Chat settings: other companies, channels, AI
rooms.people_intro: Invite colleagues by their work email; they choose their password with the link in the invitation (valid for 7 days).
rooms.people_not_rooms: Your company manages its people in Xenaxio (Administration → Employees).
rooms.people_remove_confirm: Remove {email} from your company? Their chat account is closed; their messages stay.
rooms.plan_free_federation: Chat with other companies opens on {date}.
rooms.plan_free_more: More people or space? Ask us
rooms.plan_free_usage: {people} of {maxPeople} people · {used} of {storage} GB for files
rooms.reset_submit: Save password and open the chat
rooms.reset_subtitle: Choose a new password for your account at {company}.
rooms.signup_closed: Sign-up is not open on this installation. Ask us for access.
rooms.signup_confirm_submit: Create company and open the chat
rooms.signup_consent: I agree that Xenaxio processes my details to run XenRooms for my company.
rooms.signup_free_note: Free: up to 10 people and 5 GB for files, chat with other companies after 7 days. More on request.
rooms.signup_link_expired: This link has expired. Please sign up again.
rooms.signup_link_used: This link was already used. Sign in with your email and password.
rooms.signup_sent: We sent a link to {email}. Open it within 24 hours to create your company.
rooms.signup_subtitle: Team chat for up to 10 people, free. Your email stays where it is; colleagues join with their work email.
rooms.start_submit: Create company and open the chat
rooms.start_subtitle: Your team chat without changing your email: your company gets its own chat address, and colleagues join with their work email.
rooms.too_many: At most {max} accounts in one browser.
rooms.work_email_hint: Your existing email – Google, Microsoft or any other. Your email stays where it is.
